payload.summary: Resolved all six independent plan-review findings by binding production promotion to an immutable CI-passed revision, moving rollback capture before deployment, and specifying a one-shot production canary with durable correlated evidence.
completed_work: Added the sanitized production evidence template
Added Node 22 and focused workflow-client test parity
Revalidated strict OpenSpec and the work-package DAG

decisions.title: Require exact-SHA release promotion
decisions.rationale: A local build is insufficient evidence that the production revision passed the release gate.

decisions.title: Capture rollback before mutation
decisions.rationale: A release must not begin unless the prior successful deployment is identifiable and recoverable.

decisions.title: Use one labeled URL canary
decisions.rationale: A forced-webpage example.com command exercises the canonical durable-operation path with minimal external effect and no automatic retry.

next_steps: Commit the approved plan and execute test-first work packages.

relevant_files.description: Immutable release and production proof decisions
